title: Meta Wonder vs Wonder Full: Who Can Actually Use Them? #shorts
description:
Meta introduced two Muse Wonder models on October 12. Wonder is available to developers via the Meta Model API and Muse Code; Wonder Full is available to Muse Code subscribers. The Muse personal-agent integration is coming later, starting with subscribers—not automatically to everyone's Instagram, WhatsApp or Meta AI chat.

Meta describes two ideas: Active Memory and Active Focus. Which sounds more useful? Comment MEMORY or FOCUS. See our full Muse Wonder breakdown on FlowMinute Lab.

Official details: https://about.fb.com/news/2026/10/introducing-muse-wonder-models/
Research: https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-wonder
